The only changed file is a test file (`lib/generator/__tests__/shortlist-size.test.ts`). Per the review instructions, test/mock files are explicitly out of scope ("Do NOT report: ... test/mock files"). The file:

- Imports pure functions from sibling modules (`buildCandidates`, `rankTopN`, `diversify`)
- Constructs synthetic in-memory closet data
- Asserts on shortlist sizes and distinctness

There are no entry points, no sinks (no shell/exec, SQL, FS writes, network calls, HTML rendering, deserialization, or logging of sensitive data), no auth/policy logic, and no attacker-influenceable inputs. Nothing in this diff has security-relevant behavior.
